test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) holders are:

options.text: Persons entitled to hold constitutional posts
Dual citizens of India and another country

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Foreign nationals with special privileges**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Overseas Citizen of India (OCI)** is a special status provided to **foreign nationals of Indian origin** by the Government of India under Section 7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955.
 
• OCI status does not grant **dual citizenship**. Instead, it provides foreign nationals with **special privileges** such as visa-free travel to India and certain rights to participate in economic and educational activities.
 
• OCI cardholders are allowed to live and work in India indefinitely without the need for a visa.
 
• However, they do not have **voting rights**, cannot hold **constitutional posts**, or contest elections in India.
 
• OCI cardholders can own property in India except for agricultural land, plantation property, or a farmhouse.
 
• This status is primarily aimed at the **Indian diaspora** to help them stay connected to their roots while residing abroad.
 
• The scheme was introduced in **2005** and later merged with the Person of Indian Origin (PIO) card scheme in **2015**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Persons entitled to hold constitutional posts**__

 __
 
• Only **Indian citizens** are eligible to hold constitutional posts such as the President, Vice-President, Prime Minister, or Chief Justice of India.
 
• OCI holders are foreign nationals and are thus not entitled to hold such posts.
 
 
 
• **Indian citizens with voting rights**__
 __
 
• OCI cardholders are not **Indian citizens**, hence they do not have voting rights. Only individuals with Indian citizenship are eligible to vote in elections.
 
 
 
• **Dual citizens of India and another country**__
 
 
• India does not allow **dual citizenship**. It only provides the OCI card as a recognition of a person’s Indian origin and to grant certain privileges.
